title: Spring Boot
description: Covers Spring Boot application development, from Maven build management and Spring Boot fundamentals to database integration, monitoring, logging, REST API development, Spring Data JPA, validation, API documentation, and REST client communication. Students will learn to build, test, and maintain Java backend applications using the Spring ecosystem.

topics.title: Maven Basics, Build Lifecycle, Dependency Management and pom.xml
topics.description: Understand Maven as a build automation and project management tool. Learn the standard project structure, build lifecycle, commonly used commands, and dependency management through the pom.xml file.
subtopics: Dependency scopes: compile, provided, runtime, test, and system
Maven local, central, and remote repositories
Maven build lifecycle and its phases
Common Maven commands: clean, compile, test, package, install, and deploy

topics.title: Spring Boot Introduction, Advantages and First Spring Boot Application
topics.description: Understand Spring Boot, its features, and advantages over traditional Spring configuration. Generate, configure, and run a first Spring Boot application using Spring Initializr.
subtopics: Features and advantages of Spring Boot
Running the first Spring Boot application

topics.title: Database Connection and JSP UI Setup in Spring Boot
topics.description: Configure database connectivity in a Spring Boot application and set up JSP as a view technology. Explore datasource properties, database connection verification, JSP view resolution, and project setup considerations.
subtopics: Database URL, username, password, and driver configuration
Packaging and deployment considerations for JSP

topics.title: Spring Boot Internals: run() Method and @SpringBootApplication
topics.description: Explore how a Spring Boot application starts and understand the role of SpringApplication.run(), application context creation, component scanning, and auto-configuration.
subtopics: Understanding the Spring Boot main class

topics.title: Lombok and Its Annotations
topics.description: Understand Project Lombok and how it reduces Java boilerplate code. Explore annotations for generating constructors, getters, setters, object methods, and builder patterns.
subtopics: Introduction to Lombok and its advantages
Adding Lombok dependency and IDE support
Using Lombok in entity, DTO, and model classes

topics.title: Spring Boot Actuator
topics.description: Use Spring Boot Actuator to monitor and manage applications. Explore health, information, and metrics endpoints, endpoint configuration, and security considerations.

topics.title: Logging in Spring Boot: Frameworks and Logging Levels
topics.description: Understand application logging and its importance in debugging and monitoring. Explore common logging frameworks, logging levels, and Spring Boot logging configuration.
subtopics: Logging levels: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, and ERROR
Custom log patterns and log files

topics.title: REST API Fundamentals and HTTP
topics.description: Understand REST architecture and HTTP communication between clients and servers. Explore REST principles, resources, endpoints, HTTP methods, request and response structures, and status code categories.
subtopics: Introduction to web services and REST APIs
HTTP methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE
Overview of HTTP status code categories

topics.title: Building CRUD REST APIs Using @RestController and Mapping Annotations
topics.description: Develop RESTful CRUD endpoints using Spring Boot. Explore controller annotations, bind request data, and implement create, read, update, and delete operations.

topics.title: HTTP Responses, Status Codes and ResponseEntity
topics.description: Understand how Spring Boot REST APIs return HTTP responses. Explore status codes, response headers, response bodies, and the ResponseEntity class for controlling complete HTTP responses.
subtopics: Common success, client-error, and server-error status codes
Returning response data from controller methods
Selecting appropriate status codes for CRUD operations

topics.title: Spring Data JPA: CrudRepository, Pagination and Sorting
topics.description: Understand Spring Data JPA repository abstractions and use CrudRepository for common database operations. Implement pagination and sorting to retrieve records efficiently.
subtopics: save(), findById(), findAll(), existsById(), and delete methods

topics.title: JpaRepository and JPA Queries: Query Methods and @Query Annotation
topics.description: Explore JpaRepository and its capabilities over CrudRepository. Learn to create derived query methods and define custom JPQL or native SQL queries using the @Query annotation.
subtopics: Query method keywords: And, Or, Between, LessThan, GreaterThan, Like, and In
Sorting and ordering in query methods
Writing native SQL queries using nativeQuery

topics.title: Swagger and OpenAPI Documentation
topics.description: Understand API documentation and configure Swagger UI with the OpenAPI specification. Document REST endpoints, request parameters, request bodies, response models, and status codes.
subtopics: Documenting request parameters and request bodies
Testing REST APIs through Swagger UI

topics.title: DTO and ModelMapper in Spring Boot
topics.description: Understand Data Transfer Objects and their role in separating API models from persistence entities. Use ModelMapper to convert between DTOs and entity objects.
subtopics: Why DTOs are used in application architecture
Using DTOs in controller and service layers

topics.title: Exception Handling in Spring Boot REST APIs
topics.description: Implement centralized exception handling in Spring Boot REST applications. Explore custom exceptions, controller-level and global exception handling, and structured error responses.
subtopics: Introduction to exception handling in REST APIs

topics.title: Validation in Spring Boot Using Spring Validator
topics.description: Validate incoming request data using Bean Validation annotations and custom validation logic through Spring's Validator interface. Learn to return clear validation error responses.
subtopics: Bean Validation and Jakarta Validation overview
Introduction to the Spring Validator interface

topics.title: Spring Profiles and Environment-Based Configuration
topics.description: Maintain separate configurations for development, testing, and production environments using Spring Profiles and externalized configuration.
subtopics: Using @Profile on configuration classes and beans

topics.title: REST Clients in Spring Boot: RestTemplate and WebClient
topics.description: Understand how Spring Boot applications communicate with external REST APIs. Explore RestTemplate for synchronous HTTP communication and WebClient for reactive, non-blocking communication.
subtopics: Configuring RestTemplate as a Spring bean
Using exchange() with HttpEntity and HttpMethod
Passing request headers and request bodies
Synchronous versus reactive and non-blocking communication
